findings.summary: vitest@^2 silently ignores test.projects (v3-only API); integration suite + testTimeout=60000 are dead config and integration tests will never run.
findings.suggested_fix: Use vitest v2 workspace API: set test.workspace=['./vitest.unit.config.ts','./vitest.integration.config.ts'] with two sibling configs, OR bump devDependency vitest to ^3 to make projects work. Verify with `pnpm exec vitest list` showing both suites.

findings.summary: exports points to './src/index.ts' but contracts emits only .d.ts (emitDeclarationOnly); Node ESM cannot load .ts at runtime so production apps/api (compiled JS) cannot resolve @medbridge/contracts.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop emitDeclarationOnly in packages/contracts/tsconfig.json, emit JS to dist/, and set exports={'.':{import:'./dist/index.js',types:'./dist/index.d.ts'}}. Alternatively, document contracts as TS-source-only and have apps/api bundle it.

findings.summary: build script `tsc -b && cp -r src/db/migrations dist/db/migrations` will fail today: src/db/migrations does not exist (lands in wave-5).
findings.suggested_fix: Guard the copy: `tsc -b && mkdir -p dist/db && ([ -d src/db/migrations ] && cp -r src/db/migrations dist/db/migrations || true)`. Tighten once migrations wave lands.

findings.summary: No project `references` to packages/contracts though contracts is composite and apps/api imports it; `tsc -b` from apps/api won't rebuild contracts and IDE go-to-def may degrade.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `"references": [{"path": "../../packages/contracts"}]` to apps/api/tsconfig.json so `tsc -b` rebuilds contracts when its sources change.

findings.summary: Runtime dep @hono/node-server is not in ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3 allow-list; required by Hono on Node but no ADR documents the choice.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a note in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3 listing @hono/node-server as the Hono Node adapter, or capture it in tech-stack ADR.

findings.summary: File on disk now re-exports './auth.js' (added by wave-3 commit 97c93ef); wave-2 scaffold originally produced an empty barrel — current content is post-wave-2 drift, not a wave-2 defect.
findings.suggested_fix: No action for wave-2; review-wave-3 already audits the auth.ts re-export. Informational pointer that the on-disk content differs from the wave-2 commit (0ba770d).
